days_meaning: each delivery day costs you this much cash

messages.text: Hello, and thank you for meeting me. I would propose 63 P with delivery on day 10.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 48 P, delivery on day 8, please?
Fair enough, thank you. I will meet you partway: 47 P with delivery on day 6.
Thank you, we are getting close. 49 P and delivery on day 4 works for me.
